dataset.name: disease_dataset / Plant Disease Recognition (Kaggle emmarex/plantdisease)
dataset.unsupported_sampling: Deterministic sample of direct pepper and tomato class folders with seed 42.

validation_design: File-level random 80/20 held-out split with seed 42; validation images are not used for gradient updates.
limitations: disease_dataset-style images may not represent Rwanda field backgrounds, lighting, cultivars or all potato disorders.
The healthy class has 152 images, compared with 1000 early-blight and 1000 late-blight images.
The unsupported class improves rejection of included pepper and tomato images but cannot represent every possible non-potato photograph.
Validate on an independent Rwanda field dataset before clinical or automatic treatment use.
